maddeler.e:
ينفقع (form VII)
# يَنْفَقِعُ (yanfaqiʕu) /jan.fa.qi.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَقَعَ (infaqaʕa)
# يَنْفَقِعَ (yanfaqiʕa) /jan.fa.qi.ʕa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَقَعَ (infaqaʕa)
# يَنْفَقِعْ (yanfaqiʕ) /jan.fa.qiʕ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْفَقَعَ (infaqaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
